ISRG_2004_p28__paragraph_0.ocr:
The remaining restructuring reserve balance at December 31, 2004 of $0.5 million, which relates entirely to the remaining cost of the leased facility net of
subleasing rental income, will be fully utilized in 2007.

ISRG_2004_p28__paragraph_1.ocr:
The following table summarizes sales and the da Vinci Surgical System unit sales trend between 2002 and 2004. Overall sales increased from $72.0
million in 2002 to $91.7 million in 2003 to $138.8 million in 2004. Sales growth during this period reflected growth in both product sales and service sales as
discussed in more detail below.

ISRG_2004_p28__paragraph_2.ocr:
Product sales increased to $116.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2004 from $80.6 million for the year ended December 31, 2003. The $35.7
million increase was due to higher sales of systems, instruments, and accessories. System sales increased to $78.8 million in 2004 from $61.8 million in
2003 reflecting growth in system unit sales of da Vinci Surgical Systems and da Vinci fourth arms. 76 systems were sold in 2004,
